feeds.title: It's Not Hou It's Me
feeds.description: It's Not Hou It's Me is an indispensable resource for Houston residents to learn about the hippest places in town. From trending restaurants and new fitness studios to cultural events and art installations, we provide inside tips for readers to fall in love with their hometown!

feeds.title: Visit Houston Blog
feeds.description: See what's going on in Houston with the latest news on events, dining, things to do and other activities!

feeds.title: Houstonia Magazine
feeds.description: Houstonia is a news, entertainment and information source as smart, exciting and vital as the people who call Houston home. Each day, we canvass the nation's fourth-largest city in search of the newsmakers and tastemakers, people who are changing the way we eat, play, dress and think. Chock-full of timely, engaging stories, as well as spectacular photography and cutting-edge design, our goal is a signature mix of in-depth news stories, provocative essays, and guides to the best of the city that no Houstonian can live without.

feeds.title: BethieLife
feeds.description: Beth Muecke is a Fashion and Lifestyle Blogger in Houston, Texas. BethieLife covers everything that's fashionable and fabulous in Houston.

feeds.title: Honey We're Home
feeds.description: Honey We're Home is a lifestyle blog where Megan shares her passion for style, home decor, organization and fitness, with a good bit of family life and baby tips in there. Find blogs on organizing your home.

feeds.title: Mocha Man Style
feeds.description: Mocha Man Style is the best lifestyle site for men. We cover fashion, cars, travel, music, sports, technology, grooming, and health/fitness. Our mission is to deliver valuable content that resonates in the lives of modern men.

feeds.title: It's All Chic to Me
feeds.description: It's All Chic To Me is a Houston, TX-based fashion and lifestyle blog by Shelbi Lynne. While here, you can bet to see everything from fashion, beauty, and travel guides to her favorite Houston spots and just about anything else that I find inspiring, motivating, or beautiful. Explore more fashion, styles, and trends from her blog.

feeds.title: Lifestyle of Beauty and Skin
feeds.description: Felice shares articles about all things beauty, skin lifestyle, healthy and advice and reviews about the latest trends in the beauty industry! She talks about luxury, high end brands and also drug store beauty so she can reach all price levels! She loves playing with makeup, showing off the color with swatches and creating different types of looks.

feeds.title: STEPHANO Blog
feeds.description: Stephano is a blogger and photographer in Houston, TX. She is a Japanese pop culture otaku with a huge appetite. Stephano first started blogging about her alternative fashion style inspired by Harajuku street fashion. She draws inspiration for her dark fantasy gothic style from lolita fashion, ouji fashion, androgynous style, and visual kei.

feeds.title: Reesa Rei
feeds.description: Hey, it's Reesa Rei! Welcome to my corner of the internet where I share my travel adventures, lifestyle interests, and musical pursuits.

feeds.title: Bella Style Living
feeds.description: Houston lifestyle blogger Maria Munoz shares attainable style, beauty and lifestyle finds and inspirations for the girl on the go. check out the latest in attainable fashion + beauty with a little lifestyle finds in between.

feeds.title: Uptown with Elly Brown
feeds.description: Houston blogger Uptown with Elly Brown welcomes you into her world of fashion, beauty and parenting. Read her regular tips & inspirations here!

Featured on various websites like Delish, Brit Co, and Cosmopolitan, Elle Talk has become one of the internet's favorite happy hour spots.
